	is_shown = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_visible = yes }
}
aov_inv_mystic_ciphers_unlocked_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_unlocked = yes }
}
aov_inv_mystic_ciphers_undiscovered_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_unlocked = yes NOT = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_discovered = yes } }
}
aov_inv_mystic_ciphers_activate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_discovered = yes NOT = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_active = yes } }
	is_valid = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_available = yes aov_artificery_has_free_slot = yes }
	effect = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_activate = yes }
}
aov_inv_mystic_ciphers_deactivate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_active = yes }
	effect = {
		aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_deactivate = yes
		aov_artificery_start_slot_cooldown = yes
	}
}
aov_inv_mystic_ciphers_offered_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_offered = yes aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_discoverable = yes }
}
aov_inv_mystic_ciphers_research_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { aov_artificery_can_start_research = yes aov_invention_mystic_ciphers_discoverable = yes }
	effect = { aov_artificery_start_technomancers_research = { CATEGORY = society TARGET = mystic_ciphers } }
}
# Never executed: its tooltip shows the invention's effects
aov_inv_mystic_ciphers_effects_sgui = {
	scope = character
	effect = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_mystic_ciphers } }
}

aov_inv_runethought_network_undiscovered_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_runethought_network_unlocked = yes NOT = { aov_invention_runethought_network_discovered = yes } }
}
aov_inv_runethought_network_activate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_runethought_network_discovered = yes NOT = { aov_invention_runethought_network_active = yes } }
	is_valid = { aov_invention_runethought_network_available = yes aov_artificery_has_free_slot = yes }
	effect = { aov_invention_runethought_network_activate = yes }
}
aov_inv_runethought_network_deactivate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_runethought_network_active = yes }
	effect = {
		aov_invention_runethought_network_deactivate = yes
		aov_artificery_start_slot_cooldown = yes
	}
}
aov_inv_runethought_network_offered_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_runethought_network_offered = yes aov_invention_runethought_network_discoverable = yes }
}
aov_inv_runethought_network_research_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { aov_artificery_can_start_research = yes aov_invention_runethought_network_discoverable = yes }
	effect = { aov_artificery_start_technomancers_research = { CATEGORY = society TARGET = runethought_network } }
}
# Never executed: its tooltip shows the invention's effects

	scope = character
	effect = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_runethought_network } }
}
